text:
Anita R.: Drafting a concise runbook for new region/cluster bring-up (GPU pools, networking, validation, cost checks). Putting a rough checklist here — please comment on gaps.
Kevin M.: sharing the draft, ty. quick q — which GPU SKUs are we standardizing on for this region? A100 vs H100? also quotas?
Anita R.: plan is H100 for perf-critical pools, A100s for standard. we need quota requests early. snippet for quota request (GCP example):
```bash
gcloud compute quotas list --project=my-project --filter="metric:GENERIC_GPU"
# request via support ticket: include project, region, GPU type, desired count
```
Also add to runbook: expected provisioning lead times (usually 48-72h for GPU quota approvals in new regions).
Samir K.: add perf-validation step: spin up 1 x H100 node, run perf smoke test + 1k token / sec generator to validate sustained throughput. script:
```bash
# run on node
docker run --gpus all -e MODEL=redwood-xl ./perf-smoke.sh --seq 2048 --tokens 10000
```
Record p95 latency, token/s, and GPU mem pressure. If p95 > 250ms for 512 tokens, fail and escalate.
Lisa T.: networking gotcha we hit last time: cloud-provider default MTU in region X was 1400, caused grpc fragmentation with NVLink mesh. add a check:
- verify VPC MTU >= 1472
- check node-to-node MTU with iperf3
- ensure routes to control-plane subnets have BGP communities set for private peering
Anita R.: good call. I'll add a 'network validation' section: basic checks + common fixes. Also adding a temporary CIDR map we used:
```text
control-plane: 10.10.0.0/24
gpu-pool-1: 10.10.10.0/24
gpu-pool-2: 10.10.11.0/24
```
Make sure customers/private endpoints don't overlap.
Kevin M.: cost check: estimate monthly baseline if we run 10 H100s 24/7 w/ reserved discounts. put the formula in runbook so PM/finance can sanity-check.
Anita R.: added a quick calc section + link to cost sheet template. also added escalation matrix. Short version:
- Provisioning: infra eng
- Validation: perf eng (Samir)
- Handoff: SRE (Lisa)
Include Slack contact, runbook PR owner, and on-call pager.
Samir K.: troubleshooting notes for model failures:
- symptoms: OOM during init -> check driver + CUDA/ROCm mismatch
- check dmesg for GPU reset messages
- check nv_peer_mem / nvidia-driver versions
Lisa T.: known issue to include: "Intermittent control-plane API 504 in region Y" — root cause was NAT gateway scaling. mitigation steps:
1) increase NAT instances or enable autoscale
2) route control-plane traffic via dedicated subnets
3) temporary: set fallback to us-west-1 for control-plane until NAT stabilized
Add the exact cloud console paths and CLI commands.
Oncall Bot: NOTE: capacity-alert on 2024-03-03T14:02Z triggered because GPU pool H100-prod reached 90% allocation. Please review autoscale and overflow policies. #automated
Anita R.: for handoff checklist to SRE:
- ownership ticket created in JIRA (template link)
- upload cluster inventory (node IDs, IPs, GPU types)
- runbook PR merged and linked
- add SRE runbook entries for daily health checks and cost alerts
Marta S.: who owns long-term runbook maintenance? we need a cadence. propose quarterly review owned by "cluster-ops" with reviewers from perf, infra, and security.
Kevin M.: LGTM on quarterly. also request adding a tiny section: "rollback plan" — how to decommission cluster and reclaim GPUs without leaving stray storage or routes.
Anita R.: added rollback steps + a checklist to validate resource deletion: PVs, load balancers, routes, firewall rules, reserved ips.
Samir K.: small nit: include pointer to benchmark dataset + evaluation script for quality regression after model variant changes.
Anita R.: done. thanks all. I'll open the PR and ping reviewers. If you see anything urgent, drop it here or @me. :shipit: 

Lisa T.: ack. i'll add SRE playbook stubs once PR is up. :thumbsup:
